title: Health Insurance Marketplace - Open Enrollment
facts: HealthCare.gov Marketplace Open Enrollment runs from November 1 through January 15 each year.
Enrollment or plan changes completed by December 15 can generally start January 1 if the first premium is paid.
Enrollment completed from December 16 through January 15 generally starts February 1 if the first premium is paid.
Medicaid and CHIP applications are not limited to the Marketplace Open Enrollment window.
